summary: Jeep rolled over on Lake Como Road approximately two miles from the Como Trailhead; three passengers, one ejected. Two injured and one seriously injured. AVSAR 4x4 specialist and team brought all three down: the first two taken to San Luis Valley Regional Medical Center via ambulance, the third flown to Park View Hospital in Pueblo.
location: Lake Como Road, ~2 mi from Como Trailhead
notes: One of the injured was an AVSAR team member.
